journey.name: Create and edit a routine
journey.description: A user creates a routine with two steps, reorders them, saves it, and finds it in the routines list.

actions.action: Type "Stand up" into the "Step name" field and tap "Done"
Type "Drink water" into the "Step name" field and tap "Done"
Verify the steps are listed in the order "Stand up", "Drink water"
Tap the button that moves "Drink water" up
Verify the steps are listed in the order "Drink water", "Stand up"
Verify the Routines screen lists "Desk reset"
Verify the routine shows the steps "Drink water" and "Stand up" in that order
